### Executive (italiano semplice)

Oggi il PDF del preventivo stampa solo il nome del committente. I computi veri delle imprese portano in testa nome, indirizzo, codice fiscale e partita IVA del cliente. Il blocco va stampato con i dati com'erano al momento dell'invio, e se un dato fiscale manca l'impresa vede un promemoria senza essere bloccata.

### Not a duplicate because

Searched: gh issue list --state all for 'C2 commessa', 'registro costi', 'job economics', 'rapportino', 'da approvare cantiere', 'contratto API SAL', 'baseline cantiere', 'committente in:title'; sub-issues of #505; Serena get_symbols_overview on backend/app/commessa. Found: #1653 (open: VAT rate chosen per quote and how the total is shown by client type, stays there), #813 and #767 (closed: PDF description and header text). None prints the client block.

### Motivation

Riga 0d del piano `docs/areas/sal/plans/open/sal-v1.md`, decisione in `docs/adr/2026-08-31-committente-cantiere-commessa.md` §8.3-§8.4; regole in `docs/areas/sal/audits/2026-10-05-regole-fiscali-preventivo-committente.md`. Il PDF nasce in `backend/app/preventivo/services/pdf.py` e legge lo snapshot, mai la chiave del committente. Dipende dalla issue 0c.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The PDF prints a block with name, address, codice fiscale and P.IVA taken from the snapshot frozen at send time: `pytest` covers 4 client types (privato, ditta individuale, società, condominio), exit code 0
- [ ] Editing the committente record after sending changes 0 bytes of the sent PDF; a new send picks up the new data, asserted by `pytest`
- [ ] A missing fiscal datum shows 1 reminder line in the app («Manca la P.IVA · Aggiungi») and never blocks the PDF: `vitest` asserts the send button stays enabled
- [ ] No AI disclaimer and 0 em-dash characters in the printed block: the existing copy `pytest` on the PDF stays green

### Adversarial verification (run before merge/deploy)

- [ ] 4 generated PDFs, one per client type, compared side by side with 4 real quotes of the pilot Impresa: every field of the real heading is present, evidence in the real-test receipt
- [ ] A committente with only the name: the PDF prints 1 line and no empty labels, `pytest` asserts the absence of `None` and of dangling separators
- [ ] `pytest backend/tests/test_pdf_destinatario_cantiere.py` red on the new cases before the change, green after

### Out of scope

VAT rate, withholding and reverse charge (#1653 and later work, after an accountant confirms the rules). Invoices (C6).

### Domain

commessa

### Priority

p2

### AFK eligibility (may an unattended agent claim this?)

no (afk:human)

Verified against `origin/main` @ ac11056aa.

- Confirmed: `backend/app/preventivo/services/pdf.py` has only `committente: str = ""` — no address/codice fiscale/P.IVA block, no 'Spettabile' heading, no per-client-type (privato/ditta/società/condominio) handling.
- Correctly scoped as depending on #1718 (committente record/snapshot) — #1718 is still open (verified this run), so this one is sequentially blocked, not wrong.
- Not a duplicate: #1653 stays VAT-rate-scoped; #813/#767 (closed) only touched description/header copy, neither prints the client block.

Verdict: **ready** (blocked on #1718, as the issue itself states). `hermes:verified` added, no other label changes.
— issue-verifier (HolyClaude)

Presa in carico da @acme-owner il 2026-10-14. Branch `feat/1719-intestazione-committente` (sopra `feat/1718-committente-suggerisce`, PR #1834), worktree `.worktrees/committente-0d`.

Scelta di disegno, coerente con ADR 2026-08-31 §2.5-2.6 e §8.3: il blocco «Spett.le» si fotografa sul Preventivo quando l'Impresa sceglie il committente, e si aggiorna solo con un suo gesto su quel preventivo («Cambia», oppure «Aggiungi» dal promemoria, che salva la scheda e rifotografa). Il PDF non legge mai l'anagrafica: correggere un CAP in anagrafica non riscrive un preventivo già mandato. Nuova colonna `quotes.committente_intestazione` (migrazione additiva `20261014210000`). Dentro anche B1: la data nel titolo composto è il giorno italiano.
